context:
REINSTATED 20:08 CST Nov 14 (coordinator; the question crossed with its own withdrawal, stamped by triage): the dry fold shows the five fold clean; the coordinator starts g1 only on your answer.
Goal: fewer serial CI runs for the docs-only PRs that wait, without breaking your ruling on combines.
Problem (rule): your ruling 826 a (02:14 CST Nov 14) says per-lane merge by priority now and "no hand-built combines" while the combine train is built and measured. That wording is the consultant's and the coordinator's reading, and the ruling says another reading is possible; your own quote there is "can't we do a while work on building b". The consultant told the coordinator at 20:06 CST to have lane g1 hand-build one docs-only combine of #3396, #3431, #3428, #3391 and #3430 as the measurement. merge/combine_train.py (on main, #3392) is a dry run only: no push, no gh pr ready, no PR, and its checks line reads unknown (the coordinator's read, unverified by triage). So the combine still needs a hand build, and the reading "no hand-built combines" still stands against option a. Only you can lift your own ruling; your 20:01 words ("lanes with work ready ie tournament batching") lean toward batching but do not name this act.
Dry fold (the coordinator's read, unverified by triage): merge/combine_train.py on origin/main 261bdcecad, 20:07 to 20:08 CST: 5 members in, 0 left out, clash rate 0/4, 3 dry rounds 0.52 min, wall 31.6 s, exit 0; fast checks ok (4 checks); lint and CI not run (n/a). Triage's earlier read that #3428, #3430 and #3391 clash in docs/debts/notes.md was WRONG: .gitattributes merges that file by union (decision notes-merge-union). Not measured: ready-mark-to-merge wall for a combine; whether each PR's review record carries to a combined tree.
Correction: an earlier triage message told the coordinator no ruling forbids one combined docs-only PR. That was too short. Ruling 826 a has "no hand-built combines" (a reading, open); ruling 767 a allows combined PRs.
Based on (ruling): own-826-a-now-build-b, its sentence "no hand-built combines" (a roadmap record; the reading is not yours).
Based on (ruling): own-767-a-combined-pr: "A PR merges alone; it may combine several reviewed lanes as one PR when that saves CI" (#3429 is one, built before 826 a was read as a stop).
Based on (read): the coordinator's read of merge/combine_train.py on main and the consultant's relay of your 20:01 chat; triage read neither the tool, the train steps (combine-train-tool, fast-checks-before-ready) nor any PR.
Departs from: main's practice (runner 10 merges each docs PR alone, each on its own ready run) — one hand-built combined PR of five docs-only PRs through lane g1, wall time from first ready mark to merge measured against the per-lane runs of the same week.
Meanwhile: the coordinator holds the combine; g1 builds nothing; runner 10 keeps merging per lane. The coordinator recommends a (named 20:05 CST, before the dry-run fact above; its recommendation is unchanged).
home: ruling own-826-a-now-build-b; ruling own-767-a-combined-pr; step combine-train-tool; PRs #3396, #3431, #3428, #3391, #3430
